name: cloudflare-cookie-consent
description: A cookie banner decided at the edge: a Cloudflare Worker reads the consent cookie on the request and sends HTML whose non-consented tags are already inert. No CMP script, no flash of tracking.

scripts.check: for f in scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs test/helpers/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.example: cd example && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.check:example: node scripts/check-consent.mjs example/public && node scripts/check-consent-live.mjs http://localhost:8787 --paths /,/about,/cookie-information --expect-blocked 2
